# 273_R6OPS.5 — alerting/paging cluster (RH-27 code half + RH-20/21-residual/22)

## What

Handoff row — the alerting/paging cluster's **code half**. Operator acts stay named; nothing
here performs them.

- **RH-27 — the alert policies finally have a real path to a human.** Today every prod
  AlertPolicy binds at most one `webhook_tokenauth` channel whose sink only logs — receipt, not
  a page (`docs/ops/on-call.md`). The derived `channels` list now carries up to three legs:
  (a) the existing ops webhook; (b) a NEW **`email` NotificationChannel** gated on secret config
  `rhema:opsAlertEmail` (the operator fills the key — no address committed); (c) the **GCP
  mobile-app push leg**, bound by resource name via `rhema:opsMobileChannelName`. GCP's API
  cannot mint `mobile_app` channels (console pairing is the only path — the operator's act,
  HUMAN row 274), so the program binds the paired channel by name: their remaining acts are
  pair + set + `pulumi up`, and the dated test-page arm is recorded as `D-R6OPS.5-1`.
- **RH-20 — ADR-054's burn-rate alert actually exists now.** The ADR records the §13.5
  "error-budget burn > 2×" rule as implemented for the availability SLO; only the `Slo`
  resource existed — no policy consumed it. New `apiBurnRatePolicy` uses the
  `select_slo_burn_rate` time-series selector on the real SLO resource name, threshold 2, the
  recorded 1 h burn window, `dependsOn` the Slo.
- **RH-21 residual — errors attribute to a release.** `formatRouteErrorLine` now emits
  `serviceContext.service` on every line and `serviceContext.version` when a sanitized release
  stamp is threaded — the image-baked `RHEMA_BUILD_GIT_SHA` both services already carry (the
  `/healthz` provenance value). `routeErrorLine` binds it from the request context (Omit'd from
  call-site override — a call site cannot forge the release); api + web `requestContext` accept
  and pass it.
- **RH-22 — dead edge / dead worker goes noticed.** Zero `UptimeCheck` existed. New
  `UptimeCheckConfig` per public-domain host (`domains.app` + `domains.api`, `GET /healthz`,
  `"ok":true` content match) on stages that carry domains; `uptimeFailPolicy` pages on ≥2
  failing checker regions; `uptimeAbsentPolicy` pages on `conditionAbsent` — the `check_passed`
  metric silent 15 min AND the always-on worker's `billable_instance_time` silent 15 min.
- Uptime checks and every new policy bind the same derived `channels`; domain-less stages get
  no checks (a `*.run.app` probe would only prove the GFE answered — F-OPS.1-10).

## Operator-side acts (named, not performed)

Per `D-R6OPS.5-1`: `pulumi config set --secret rhema:opsAlertEmail <addr>` → pair the Cloud
Console mobile app → `pulumi config set rhema:opsMobileChannelName <channel resource name>` →
`pulumi up` (prod mutation, theirs) → the dated **test page** (may ride a later deploy).
`D-R6OPS.5-2` carries the deploy-bound `serviceContext.version` verify.
